description.value: Joe's Farm Market is a family-run greengrocer in Tsawwassen, open since 2005, known for fresh local produce and a surprisingly broad selection of international ingredients including Asian, East European, and Italian products. Located in a small plaza in the Tsawwassen community, it has built a devoted local following for competitive pricing and genuinely friendly service. One reviewer specifically calls it a worthwhile destination on a Saturday bike ride, noting a coffee shop and the beach are nearby.
